summary: E2E UI regression run for Sync Multi-PC in v2.html. Both critical bugs from iteration_33 are FIXED and the full sync flow works end-to-end. TEST1 window.mcSync.getStatus() returns {is_premium:true, my_mode:'independent', peers:[]} with no TypeError (fix #1 verified). TEST2 direct POST /api/sync/heartbeat with MASTER key returns HTTP 200 {authorized:true, is_premium:true, plan:'MASTER', max_devices:2, current_devices:1} (fix #2 verified). Sync modal opens with both data-testid buttons; clicking sync-btn-linked shows toast '🔗 Fusionado activado' and modal closes; re-opening shows the Fusionado button in green with ✓. sync-btn-independent works. sync-send-backup with label 'Test Master Copia' works and the backup is retrievable from the second PC. PC2 simulation succeeds: no license re-ask, getStatus() shows peers with the previous install_id, getPendingBackup() returns count=1 with the correct label and 11 keys, and the onboarding modal 'Detectamos otro ordenador' auto-appears. Tab navigation (Contabilidad, Estadísticas, Configuración) works with 0 JS errors on the console.
critical_code_review_comments: v2.html is now ~10.8k lines — still recommend splitting license/sync/config/contabilidad modules; not blocking but violates <700 line guideline.

Naming inconsistency (license_key vs key) is patched at the initSync call site but the underlying dual-field convention remains. Consider a single normalize helper e.g. getLicenseKey() to prevent this class of bug in the future.
One 403 on a background resource observed (Failed to load resource 403) — non-blocking but worth auditing which asset returns 403 for anonymous users.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on sync flow (7/7 test cases: getStatus, heartbeat, modal open, linked toggle, independent toggle, send-backup, PC2 peers+pending backup) + tabs regression OK

Fix #1 lives at v2.html:10731 (`const licKey = lic && (lic.license_key || lic.key)`), Fix #2 lives at /app/backend/routes/sync.py:38-50 with a synthetic MASTER license (MASTER plan_family, treated as premium, bypasses DB lookup).
